info.title: XLC Mi Fitness Read-Only Health
info.description: Read the account owner's Xiaomi Mi Fitness synchronized data, with the owner's explicit authorization. No live measurements or medical diagnosis. Uses the existing /health endpoint.

get.summary: Read consented sleep, heart rate, steps or daily summary for a date
get.description: Read synchronized Xiaomi Mi Fitness data only when the account owner asks. Specify the owner's local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Missing data is not zero. Be clear that sync timestamps and timezone may lag. Do not forward measurements to unrelated services.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Local calendar day requested by the owner, YYYY-MM-DD

200.description: User-authorized, synchronized health records. Exact fields vary by Mi Fitness SDK response; never infer missing readings.

401.description: Missing or incorrect private access key

502.description: Mi Fitness unavailable or data could not be read

healthBearer.description: Use the existing Render HEALTH_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN, configured only in the GPT Action authentication UI. Never put tokens in this schema.
